newsitem.title: USA: N.J. Turnpike spent $26 mln on road plan -- paper.
newsitem.headline: N.J. Turnpike spent $26 mln on road plan -- paper.

text.p: New Jersey Turnpike Authority spent $26 million on land purchases and engineering work for a project still awaiting state and federal approval, the Star Ledger reported Wednesday.

The $298 million Route 92 project, which would connect the Turnpike to Route 1 in South Brunswick, needs final approval from the federal Environmental Protection Agency and the state Department of Environmental Protection.
A spokewoman for the authority told the newspaper that there is no set time frame for the approval process.
The project came under fire from local residents and environmentalists, who argued that the project would destroy too many wetlands. But most state officials have come out in support of the plan.
